caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental wrought iron railing comprising two repeating vertical units. Each unit features a symmetrical, decorative pattern with interlacing curves, pointed arches, and floral-like motifs, reminiscent of Gothic architectural design. The color is predominantly a metallic grey-green, with shading that suggests a patinated or aged effect. The railing has a rectangular top rail and a base featuring a crisscross lattice below the main decorative sections, each intersection highlighted with a finial. Additionally, the drawing includes two vertical cross-section views labeled A–A and B–B, both rendered to the side of the main image, and smaller sectional profiles below indicating the cross-sectional shapes of the rails. The overall presentation is technical and precise, with annotations for scale, section, and the drafter’s signature in the bottom left corner.
title: Cast Iron Balcony
